Presented by ScottyLabs & 

 TARTANHACKS is the largest Hackathon in Pittsburgh! Organized by ScottyLabs, it's a 24-hour hackathon where participants from all over the country create innovative projects. Come on over to hack, learn from our workshops and incredible speakers, and meet other hackers. 

 MOSAIC 

For 24 hours, participants stepped into a world built from fragments, floating tiles, ideas that refract and snap into place.

title: HackIllinois 2026
text:
HackIllinois 2026

HackIllinois is the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign's premier collegiate hackathon. Prospective attendees can register by the priority deadline on January 4, 2026 to be entered into a raffle to win an iPad, or the final deadline on January 27, 2026.

Participants can work individually or in teams to submit projects to a specific track for a chance to win prizes. Whether you're a beginner or an experienced hacker, HackIllinois offers workshops, mentorship, and an inclusive environment for everyone to learn and create.

### Who is eligible to attend?

HackIllinois is open to all current college students and recent graduates (within 1 year of graduation). You do not need any prior coding experience - we welcome students of all skill levels! Whether you are a beginner or an experienced hacker, there is a place for you at HackIllinois.

### Where is HackIllinois located?

HackIllinois 2026 will be held in the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign. We'll provide more detailed location and parking information closer to the event date.

### Will overnight hacking space be provided?

Yes! HackIllinois will provide overnight hacking space for attendees this year. This dedicated space allows you to work on your project throughout the night in a safe environment.

### Will there be reimbursement?

Yes! HackIllinois will offer only travel reimbursement this year to attendees that submit a qualified project. You can view details on how to qualify for reimbursem

title: ATC 2026: The 2026 ACM SIGOPS Annual Technical Conference
text:
ATC 2026: The 2026 ACM SIGOPS Annual Technical Conference

## ATC 2026 Student Scholarships and Travel Grants

ATC 2026 offers a limited number of grants to help full-time undergraduate and graduate students attend the conference in Hong Kong. Students may apply whether or not they are presenting work.

Funding is competitive and may cover conference registration and part of reasonable travel and accommodation expenses. Awards may not cover all requested costs.

### Eligibility

Applicants must:

- be enrolled full-time at an accredited institution;
- study computer science, computer engineering, or a related field;
- attend ATC 2026 in person if selected; and
- disclose all confirmed or pending funding for the trip.

Postdoctoral researchers are also eligible.

### Application Materials

Please submit:

- the completed application form;
- a CV of no more than two pages;
- proof of current full-time student status.

Applications will be evaluated based on financial need, relevance to ATC, expected benefit from attending, available institutional support, and contributions to broad participation.
